title: Manyana: A Coherent Vision For The Future Of Version Control

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if version control became a shared, decentralized infrastructure for all knowledge creation?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Modern tools like Git, Merkle trees, and DAGs already enable robust, distributed version control at scale.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But who controls the data? Centralized platforms risk monopolizing intellectual history and silencing marginalized voices.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source communities and protocols like IPFS are decentralizing storage and access, giving creators more agency.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where knowledge is collaboratively built and preserved, accessible to all without gatekeepers.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of version control lies in balancing innovation with equity — a shared foundation for human progress.

video_cue: A digital forest where trees represent code repositories, branching and merging as developers collaborate globally.
